content.short: Dino Tycoon is a TON game where players build and manage a dinosaur park while progressing through Web3 rewards.
content.description: Dino Tycoon is a browser and Telegram game built around running and expanding a dinosaur themed park. The TON app listing presents it as a management game where players upgrade attractions, complete tasks, use spins and referrals, and connect a wallet to collect rewards. The project website also references a broader AI and analytics narrative, but the live product is mainly presented to players as a tycoon style game with Web3 progression, repeat play loops, wallet linked incentives, and a steady stream of small goals to complete over time.
content.meta: Dino Tycoon is a TON park management game centered on upgrades, tasks, repeat play, and wallet linked progression rewards over time.
